title: Conjecture 4.4 — Amoroso-David
exact_target: Is the projective height of a multiplicatively independent algebraic tuple uniformly bounded below by a constant divided by the least degree of a rational polynomial vanishing at that tuple?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8700049 (AMR-086-0049). CC BY 4.0.
Michel Waldschmidt, Open Diophantine Problems, arXiv:math/0312440v2 (24 January 2004), Conjecture 4.4 and the definitions at the start of Section 4.
